systems.name: 6.1 Code Size Reduction
systems.notes: The current collision detection and input handling are very repetitive. Refactor into loops or subroutines to free ROM space for new features.
tasks: Replace cascading input bit checks with a loop over an input‑mask table
Generalize collision detection into a single subroutine
Remove duplicate sprite‑draw call stubs by using a jump table

systems.name: 6.2 Cycle Counting & Frame Rate Stability
systems.notes: Ensure the game runs at a stable frame rate even with many sprites. Profile worst‑case paths and optimize hot loops.
tasks: Count cycles in DRAW_SPRITE and optimize pixel write
Implement a simple frame limiter (wait for VBLANK) if available
